cues: Now push the plasmids into bacteria and pick out the right ones.
Only colonies with a plasmid survive on ampicillin.
Copy them onto tetracycline: those with a broken tetracycline gene die.
Those are the ones carrying your gene.
Modern vectors use the lac Z gene instead: recombinant colonies stay white on X gal, the others turn blue.
text: Now push the plasmids into bacteria and pick out the right ones. Only colonies with a plasmid survive on ampicillin. Copy them onto tetracycline: those with a broken tetracycline gene die. Those are the ones carrying your gene. Modern vectors use the lac Z gene instead: recombinant colonies stay white on X gal, the others turn blue.
